subject: general
question:
Study the given line graph and answer the following question.

The given line graph depicts the number of boys and girls in three schools (P Q and R).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/225d983e837309d82db7fc8ae89e981f627f2dec873e44aa5dca83774ef2b985.png] 

What is the average number of boys in the given three schools?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of values / No. of values 

**Calculation:**

Number of boys in school P = 200

Number of boys in school Q = 90

Number of boys in school R = 190 

Number of boys in all the three schools = 200+ 90 + 190 = 480

Number of schools = 3 

Average = Sum of values/No. of values 

⇒ 480/3 = 160 

**Hence, average number of boys in three schools is 160.**
